item.title: Readwalk 1.8
item.description: Talk to all your Claude Code sessions by voice, from one place. - One controller: you talk to one session, and Readwalk sends what you say to the right one. Other sessions give a one-line headline in their own voice, and the controller gets their full reports. - Headlines keep the question: if a session ends with a question, you hear it, then "There's more: say read the rest." - One-click pause: click the red mic, or say "pause" or "I'm on the phone", and Readwalk stops listening until you click again, press ⌃⌥⎋ or say "Hey Readwalk". There's also Pause Listening in the menu. - Talk over a reading: the mic button or ⌃⌥⎋ pauses whatever Readwalk is reading, so you don't have to wait for it to finish. - Faster feedback: the pop sounds as soon as you're heard, and a soft working tone plays while Readwalk finds the right session. - Sessions can ask you directly when they need your own approval (a sign-in, a permission), then hand you back. - "Hey Readwalk" wakes faster and understands more mishearings. Longer pauses before deciding you've finished talking. - Pronunciation: hyphenated words are read as one word (follow-up, sign-in, built-in), Wi-Fi is "WY-fy", and "read the rest" says "reed".

item.title: Readwalk 1.7
item.description: Talk to your Claude Code sessions by voice: just speak and Readwalk finds the right session. Each session has its own voice, replies reach your iPhone when you're away, and clearer pronunciation.

item.title: Readwalk 1.6
item.description: Talk to Claude Code by voice: Readwalk reads replies aloud and hears your answer (menu bar › Claude Sessions). Plus clearer pronunciation.

item.title: Readwalk 1.5
item.description: Send to iPhone now goes through your iCloud: highlighted text, the web page you're on (even pages you're signed in to), copied text, PDFs and Word documents land in Up Next on your iPhone. Redesigned widget: horizontal or vertical, three sizes, and a mini player while reading. Pronunciation fixes.

item.title: Readwalk 1.4.2
item.description: Fixes Readwalk using a large amount of memory during long listening sessions; it now stays small however long you listen. Also includes the 1.4.1 pronunciation fixes.

item.title: Readwalk 1.4.1
item.description: Pronunciation fixes: "copied" and "copies" are now said correctly, and possessive names ending in y (Cathy's, Andy's, Emily's) no longer sound like "Cath-eyes".

item.title: Readwalk 1.4
item.description: Send to iPhone right from the widget: tap the phone button, drag a file or link onto the widget, or use Send a File. Voice and Speed now have their own submenus. Clicking the Dock or menu bar icon brings the widget to the screen you're on. Numbers, prices and dates read naturally. New mascot menu bar icon.

item.title: Readwalk 1.3
item.description: Better pronunciation: "read" is said correctly in questions like "Did someone read it?".

item.title: Readwalk 1.2
item.description: New: send highlighted text to Readwalk on your iPhone (Option-Shift-Escape), and automatic updates.
